output.description: Output directory or filename pattern for downloads. Corresponds to --output.

subfolder.description: Create a subfolder titled as the show. Corresponds to --subfolder.

force.description: Overwrite if file exists already. Corresponds to -f, --force.

live.description: Enable for live streams (RTMP based ones). Corresponds to -l, --live.

capture_time.description: Capture time in minutes of a live stream. Corresponds to -c, --capture_time. Set to null to omit.

silent_semi.description: Only show a message when the file is downloaded. Corresponds to --silent-semi.

username.description: Username for authentication. Corresponds to -u, --username. Empty string omits.

password.description: Password for authentication. Corresponds to -p, --password. Empty string omits.

token.description: Token for authentication. Corresponds to --token. Empty string omits.

thumbnail.description: Download thumbnail from the site if available. Corresponds to -t, --thumbnail.

get_url.description: Do not download any video, but instead print the URL. Corresponds to -g, --get-url.

dont_verify_ssl_cert.description: Don't attempt to verify SSL certificates. Corresponds to --dont-verify-ssl-cert.

http_header.description: A header to add to each HTTP request. Format: header1=value;header2=value2. Corresponds to --http-header. Empty string omits.

cookies.description: A cookie to add to each HTTP request. Format: cookie1=value;cookie2=value2. Corresponds to --cookies. Empty string omits.

exclude.description: Exclude videos with the WORD(s) in the filename. Comma separated. Corresponds to --exclude.

after_date.description: Only videos published on or after this date (yyyy-MM-dd). Corresponds to --after-date. Empty string omits.

proxy.description: Use the specified HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS proxy. Corresponds to --proxy. Empty string omits.

verbose.description: Explain what is going on. Corresponds to -v, --verbose.

nfo.description: Create a NFO file. Corresponds to --nfo.

force_nfo.description: Download only NFO if used with --nfo. Corresponds to --force-nfo.

only_audio.description: Only download audio if audio and video is separated. Corresponds to --only-audio.

only_video.description: Only download video if audio and video is separated. Corresponds to --only-video.

quality.description: Choose what format to download based on bitrate/video resolution. Corresponds to -q, --quality. Null omits.

flexible_quality.description: Allow given quality (as above) to differ by an amount. Corresponds to -Q. Null omits.

preferred.description: Preferred download method (dash, hls, or http). Corresponds to -P, --preferred. Empty string omits.

stream_priority.description: Stream priority if two streams have the same quality (dash,hls,http). Corresponds to --stream-priority.

format_preferred.description: Choose the format you prefer (e.g. h264,h264-51). Corresponds to --format-preferred.

audio_language.description: Choose the language of the audio. Corresponds to --audio-language. Empty string omits.

video_role.description: Choose the role of the video. Corresponds to --video-role. Empty string omits.

resolution.description: Choose what video resolution to download e.g. 480,720,1080. Comma separated. Corresponds to --resolution.

subtitle.description: Download subtitle from the site if available. Corresponds to -S, --subtitle.

merge_subtitle.description: Merge subtitle with video/audio file. Corresponds to -M, --merge-subtitle.

force_subtitle.description: Download only subtitle if used with -S. Corresponds to --force-subtitle.

require_subtitle.description: Download only if a subtitle is available. Corresponds to --require-subtitle.

all_subtitles.description: Download all available subtitles for the video. Corresponds to --all-subtitles.

raw_subtitles.description: Also download the subtitles in their native format. Corresponds to --raw-subtitles.

convert_subtitle_colors.description: Converts the color information in subtitles. Corresponds to --convert-subtitle-colors.

all_episodes.description: Try to download all episodes. Corresponds to -A, --all-episodes.

all_last.description: Get last NN episodes instead of all episodes. Corresponds to --all-last. Null omits.

include_clips.description: Include clips from websites when using -A. Corresponds to --include-clips.

cmore_operator.description: CMore Operator. Corresponds to --cmore-operator. Empty string omits.

no_remux.description: Do not automatically remux to mp4. Corresponds to --no-remux.

no_merge.description: Do not automatically merge video, audio and possibly also subtitle(s). Corresponds to --no-merge.

no_postprocess.description: Do not postprocess anything. Corresponds to --no-postprocess.

keep_original.description: Do postprocessing while also keeping original files. Corresponds to --keep-original.

output_format.description: Format you want resulting file in (mkv or mp4). Corresponds to --output-format. Empty string omits.
